title: Thai Banana Pilaf
description: A warm and comforting Thai-inspired pilaf dish featuring sweet bananas and savory spices.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add grated ginger and cook for an additional minute.
Add pilaf mix and stir to combine with onion and ginger mixture.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until pilaf is lightly toasted.
Add curry powder and stir to combine.
Add sliced bananas and stir to combine with pilaf mixture.
Season with salt and sugar to taste.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until bananas are tender.
Optional: garnish with chopped fresh herbs or toasted nuts.
